title: Flow Matching with Missing Data
abstract: arXiv:2607.28698v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Flow matching assumes fully observed training data, which many real-world applications rarely provide. We study Missing-Data Flow Matching, which treats the missing coordinates of training samples as latent variables and averages the flow matching loss over the values they could take. We first prove that the oracle correction is exact: completing from the true pattern-conditioned posterior recovers the complete-data flow-matching objective under any missingness mechanism. Under missing completely at random (MCAR) and missing at random (MAR), this posterior equals the ordinary complete-data conditional, while under missing not at random (MNAR) it generally depends on the missingness mechanism and may require additional structure to identify. Our finite-sample analysis then answers design questions that the algorithm leaves open. Missingness transfers estimator variance rather than adding it, and for the fixed-parameter loss estimator

translated_abstract: 流匹配假设训练数据是完全观测的，然而许多现实应用很少能提供这样的数据。我们研究了缺失数据流匹配，该方法将训练样本的缺失坐标视为潜在变量，并在这些坐标可能的取值上对流匹配损失进行平均。我们首先证明了oracle修正的精确性：在任意缺失机制下，使用真实的模式条件后验进行补全可以恢复完整数据的流匹配目标。在完全随机缺失（MCAR）和随机缺失（MAR）下，该后验等同于普通的完整数据条件分布；而在非随机缺失（MNAR）下，它通常依赖于缺失机制，可能需要额外的结构才能识别。随后，我们的有限样本分析回答了该算法遗留的设计问题：缺失机制是转移而非额外增加估计量的方差，而对于固定参数的损失估计器……
tldr: 该论文提出缺失数据流匹配方法，将训练样本的缺失坐标视为潜在变量并证明其oracle修正在任意缺失机制下都能精确恢复完整数据的流匹配目标，同时通过有限样本分析揭示了缺失机制只是转移而非增加估计量的方差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Missing-Data Flow Matching, which treats missing coordinates of training samples as latent variables and proves that the oracle correction exactly recovers the complete-data flow-matching objective under any missingness mechanism, with finite-sample analysis showing that missingness transfers rather than adds estimator variance.
